findings.title: Bind routine completions to their initiating mechanism
findings.why_it_matters: Selecting mechanism B or deleting A while A's options, initial plan or revision is pending changes the shared I variable. The completion then writes A's response into whichever mechanism is now selected; initial generation clears that mechanism's participants, trial runs, decisions and version history. The active hub makes the sequence reachable in ordinary navigation, and reviewers reproduced options and build corruption with deferred synthetic requests. Capture and validate the initiating item/revision before settlement so navigation cannot corrupt a different mechanism.

findings.title: Isolate new demos before reading private workspaces
findings.why_it_matters: The new routines, family bridge and custom-practice flows restore and save ordinary owner workspaces even under the administrator's embedded demo gates. Demo examples can overwrite private drafts; successful routines generation clears people/history, and own-case approval can evict the oldest of twelve saved cases and clear the private draft. Restored private names/contact fields can enter demo input metadata. The ordinary practice recipe also queries the first scenario-card across both saved personal cases and the catalogue, so it can send a private case into a demonstration. Fresh demo memory before all reads prevents this shared boundary failure and prevents an old custom preview from satisfying the new demonstration.

Apply data only while that item still exists and the captured revision is current; persist its result and redraw/navigate only when it remains selected. actionable_findings.title: Bind routine completions to their initiating mechanism
actionable_findings.why_it_matters: Selecting mechanism B or deleting A while A's options, initial plan or revision is pending changes the shared I variable. The completion then writes A's response into whichever mechanism is now selected; initial generation clears that mechanism's participants, trial runs, decisions and version history. The active hub makes the sequence reachable in ordinary navigation, and reviewers reproduced options and build corruption with deferred synthetic requests. Capture and validate the initiating item/revision before settlement so navigation cannot corrupt a different mechanism.

actionable_findings.title: Isolate new demos before reading private workspaces
actionable_findings.why_it_matters: The new routines, family bridge and custom-practice flows restore and save ordinary owner workspaces even under the administrator's embedded demo gates. Demo examples can overwrite private drafts; successful routines generation clears people/history, and own-case approval can evict the oldest of twelve saved cases and clear the private draft. Restored private names/contact fields can enter demo input metadata. The ordinary practice recipe also queries the first scenario-card across both saved personal cases and the catalogue, so it can send a private case into a demonstration. Fresh demo memory before all reads prevents this shared boundary failure and prevents an old custom preview from satisfying the new demonstration.

actionable_findings.title: Preserve participation request locks across redraws
actionable_findings.why_it_matters: A pending participation suggestion only disables its original button. Selecting a card, adding a catalog card, or closing and reopening the panel redraws it with an enabled suggestion button, so users can start another charged model call while the first is running. Both completions then commit and redraw in arrival order, allowing the older result to replace the newer one.

actionable_findings.title: Include recorded decisions in routines revision context
actionable_findings.why_it_matters: A revision request omits the rejection or adaptation already recorded for each proposed change, and omits the decision journal. The model cannot distinguish unresolved requests from decisions the team has settled, so subsequent advice can repeat a rejected change or replace an agreed adaptation. Human approval still applies, but the advice loses material workspace context.
